title: Spy e-mails
summary: Who receives staff copies of ops mail. Kernel SMTP unchanged. Permission spy_mail. Register channels with mail.spy.channels.

rows: Kernel seeds KERNEL_SPY_CHANNELS. Plugins append { id, pluginId, title, description, filters }.
This plugin fills { channelId, to }. Empty to skips the send.

blocks.title: Safety
blocks.text: Role user (customers) never receive spy mail. Recipients must be existing unlocked staff accounts. Matching many filters still sends one copy per email.

items.description: spy_mail on the manifest. Nav Admin → Spy e-mails.
Channels and recipients live on /admin/spy-mail, not /admin/plugins/:id.
tuucho-contact registers contact.inbound and contact.chat. seedContactRecipient / seedChatRecipient are seed-only plugin settings.
website_down / website_restore_failed use spyTo. If DB is down, warmOutageSpy reads $PRIVATE_DIR/warm-outage/spy-recipients.json. SMTP_HOST / EMAIL_NO_REPLY_FROM stay kernel SMTP JSON.
